Short answer: Claim or add the real business, complete the official verification, and enter facts exactly as customers encounter them. Do not stuff the business name with services or neighborhoods.

What this means for your business

The profile can place your hours, phone, directions, photos, reviews, and website in Search and Maps. It must be controlled by the business and kept current.

What to watch

  • A profile already controlled by an old employee or vendor.
  • A name that differs from the real-world business name.
  • Wrong hours, phone, website, address, or service area.
  • Duplicate profiles for one location.

Do this next

  1. Search the exact business name and city first.
  2. Claim an existing profile or add the business through Google.
  3. Complete the verification option Google provides.
  4. Match the website details and test call, directions, and link.

When Little Fight fits

We can clean up the website and profile path. Google controls verification and display, so we cannot promise a method, completion time, or ranking.
